question: What uninterrupted natural abode may the fortunate one enter?
premises: the fortunate one may enter it
peaceful and risen pair arises simultaneously
inference: The fortunate one enters the uninterrupted natural abode where power and power-holder arise together.
plain_english: The uninterrupted natural abode may be entered; the fortunate one, then the pair consisting of peaceful and risen arises simultaneously from power and power-holder.
